title: Orions 2: The Deckmasters
notes: Reviewed community evidence; not a complete playthrough verification.

reviewedUserReports.notes: Exact IPA tested on POCO ARM64. Main menu and fresh-campaign greeting/OK respond. Tutorial card battle reached victory; campaign map, city and construction worked. Built Blue Crystals: resource 500 to 480. Native slot 1 saved and reloaded after emulator process restart. A second map attack entered a non-tutorial battle; repeated card plays and turns ended in ordinary defeat and return to the map. Exact executable-SHA forceComposition patch restores missing city and text layers and auto-applies in Baseline. Audio quality, frame pacing, longer campaign and emulator save states are unverified. Partial result, not a full-playthrough claim.
